2014_spells.green-flame-blade.descriptio: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and you can cause green fire to leap to a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of the target. The green fire deals fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.
2014_spells.green-flame-blade.effectSumm: Change a target: brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you
2014_spells.green-flame-blade.fullDescri: Using 1 action, you brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and you can cause green fire to leap to a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of the target; The green fire deals fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 fire damage on a hit, and the fire damage increases to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier; At 11th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8 and the fire damage increases to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier; At 17th level, the extra damage increases to 3d8 and the fire damage increases to 3d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
